name: Bai Cai Dark
vibe: Calm premium editor's cut: footage kept at natural brightness (light warm grade), thin white subtitles with green keywords, tall condensed titles, black backdrops with framed / round insets of the speaker, one neon-ish green.

reference.creator: 剪辑师白菜 (WeChat Channels)
reference.url: local: ~/Desktop/94_1793056051.mp4 (BAI CAI EDITING · 告别廉价口播, 20 s screen recording; edited video = the portrait panel)
reference.what: condensed white hook title beside the face + small green sub; thin white subtitle at chest with bigger green keywords; B&W shrink into black with green hand-written arched words; articles flying in on black with a round face inset; low-poly black backdrop + white chip '观点.1' + framed box with the speaker popping out; frosted panel with percent donuts; end card = heavy serif title on warm black, speaker in a thin white frame with head breaking out

density: A treatment every 3-5 s like the reference (it is a showreel of moves), but a real 60 s video should hold 4-6 s of plain graded face + caption between moves. Each move 2-4 s. Never two black-backdrop moves back to back.
not: no default 黑体/bold sans with thick black stroke, no white caption pills, no all-caps shouting captions
no bright or pastel backgrounds, no gradients in colour, no stickers/emoji
only one accent (green); the ring chart is the single place extra hues (violet, red) may appear
no bouncy pops or shakes; moves are smooth ease-in-out shrinks, slides and fly-ins

brand.note: brand colour replaces the green keyword/notes; titles stay Anton, end serif stays

fit.good_for: 观点、个人 IP、想显得高级的产品介绍、知识口播
fit.avoid: 活泼搞笑、儿童类、需要大量图表的稿子
